programme.title: The Losers
programme.desc: An explosive tale of double cross and revenge, "The Losers" centers upon the members of an elite U.S. Special Forces unit sent into the Bolivian jungle on a search and destroy mission. The team--Clay, Jensen, Roque, Pooch and Cougar --find themselves the target of a lethal betrayal instigated from inside by a powerful enemy known only as Max. Presumed dead, the group makes plans to even the score when they're joined by the mysterious Aisha, a beautiful operative with her own agenda. Working together, they must remain deep undercover while tracking the heavily-guarded Max, a ruthless man bent on embroiling the world in a new high-tech global war.

The kidnappers, led by devious and ruthless mastermind Bill Cox, force Paul to rob his bank and commit one of the largest thefts in history. The situation becomes more ominous when he realizes that he is being set up for embezzlement and all traces of the real thieves will vanish. What follows is a high-stakes game of cat and mouse as Paul uses his security expertise to try and turn the tables on the criminals.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.desc: When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town Talent Show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day. // Sierra Sparkle is coming to sing for Builder Cove Day! But when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 Ep.1010: Liberty's Mountain Rescue / Pups Save a Flying Farmer Yumi
programme.desc: Liberty comes to visit the pups just in time to help save the Turbots and their radar doppler in a daring mountain rescue. // When Farmer Al builds a windmill, the wind takes Farmer Yumi and Garby on a wild flight.

programme.title: Deer Squad S1 Ep.112: Sky Art / The Great Race
programme.desc: Sir Steel is upset with Lola's sky art as it affects the popularity of his hat stand, so he tries to disperse her artwork. // The Deer Squad have a race to see whose cart is the fastest, but Sir Steel unexpectedly join in with his Steelmobile!

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.512: Turtle Trouble
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, Diego, and Baby Jaguar help a baby sea turtle named Tati get home to the ocean.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.512: Dora and Diego Save The Whales
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, Diego, and Baby Jaguar venture into the sea to help a baby whale named Huicho find his lost whale family.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.115: The Curse of the Gold Falcon / The Island of Lost Things
programme.desc: Santiago and crew set sail to return the Golden Falcon idol back to it's rightful resting place. // When Santiago's magic sword is transported to the Island of Lost Things, the good pirates have to track it down by getting themselves lost!

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.102: Present / Movie / Vinny
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy and Tia can't decide on the best gift for Grandma. // Tim tries to make his own Captain DinoStar movie. // Tim fakes it to prove he's just as cool as Kai's cousin.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.201: Happy Parky
programme.desc: Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.122: The Elf Rocket / Picnic on the Moon
programme.desc: The elves build a rocket. King Thistle, Holly, Nanny Plum, Ben, Mr Elf and Gaston fly it into space to have a picnic on the moon. // Thistle and the gang meet some friendly aliens, but then they realise they do not have enough fuel to return home.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.122: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.123: Barba TV / The Museum
programme.desc: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows. // The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the Earth, Precambrian submarine and... dinosaurs!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.124: Barbazoo Can't Say ''No'' / The Doppelganger
programme.desc: Barbazoo is ready to help. But Barbabright and Barbabelle abuse his kindness and drive him crazy. // By chance, Barbazoo realizes he can imitate Barbapapa. He uses this opportunity to distribute chores to his brothers and sisters. Will they find out?

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.105: Tiny Croc / Camping Croc
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile find a tiny lizard who wants to be just like Mr. Crocodile. // Winston tries to be the leader on a nature hike, but his high-tech gadget gets everyone lost in the woods.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S2 Ep.208: The Sneaky Stick Stealer / The Puzzle of the Pink Kangaroo
programme.desc: Sam and Kit team up with night monkey detective Phillip Night to solve a mystery involving stolen sticks. // Sam and Kit are called to the savannah to investigate sightings of a "pink kangaroo"!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.312: The Crew Builds A Giant Tunnel
programme.desc: Park Ranger Rose and Rubble & Crew discover a meteorite outside of Builder Cove! But when Speed Meister and Mega Meister try to take it, the pups need their giant construction vehicles to save the town and get the meteorite to the Science Center.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.313: The Crew Builds A Mega Stunt Ramp / The Crew Builds A Solar Farm
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew use their giant trucks to make awesome stunt ramps when Speed Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition // When power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show, the pups hop in their big vehicles to turn the power back on.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S7 Ep.726: Pups save Thundermouth / Pups Save a Class Pet
programme.desc: Shortly after listening to the story of Thundermouth, the pups are on a mission to save elephants spooked by a scary noise. // Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes! Now it's up to the Paw Patrol to save the pet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S8 Ep.801: Pups Save a Runaway Rooster / Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
programme.desc: Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. // When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the Paw Patrol to bring her safely down.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.213: Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire
programme.desc: The twins visit Barbabright's room. // If I were a billionaire, what would I do to achieve my dreams?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.214: The Louvre / Opposite Day
programme.desc: On a trip to Paris, the Barbapapa family will discover the most incredible museum: the Louvre! // Barbalala has decided to respect all the rules of the day of opposites.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.105: Princess and the Pirate Puppy / Caracol Cove
programme.desc: Santi and crew will have to team up with a pirate puppy to stop Bonnie Bones and save an old friend. // Enrique's new gold-digging machine threatens Lorelai's home.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.106: The Night of the Turtles / Santiago's Regatta
programme.desc: When Bonnie kidnaps newly-hatched turtles before they can swim to momma out at sea, Santi and crew are on the move. // Santi and crew struggle to win the Isla Encanto Regatta when Enrique starts to cheat.

programme.title: Deer Squad S1 Ep.108: Fan Club / Speeding Steel
programme.desc: After Kai saves some baby turtles, they form a fan club. Full of himself, Kai tries to save the Central Forest from over-heating without his teammates. // Rammy wants to win the city marathon but he cannot keep up with Sir Steel's super sneakers!

programme.title: The Creature Cases S2 Ep.208: The Sneaky Stick Stealer / The Puzzle of the Pink Kangaroo
programme.desc: Sam and Kit team up with night monkey detective Phillip Night to solve a mystery involving stolen sticks. // Sam and Kit are called to the savannah to investigate sightings of a "pink kangaroo"!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.718: The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Peppa and Family's holiday continues. Today everyone is going to work on Mrs. Kangaroo's submarine!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.719: The Boomerang

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.725: Canal Boat

programme.title: Peppa Pig S7 Ep.726: Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog are showing and sharing their lovely, tomato filled, Greenhouses to Peppa and George.

programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama go out to celebrate their birthdays. Barbabelle is in charge and gets overwhelmed. // Barbabelle watches Bali's kittens. She's scared something will happen and won't let them out. Barbamama must intervene to help the kittens.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
